description: Reference: typical tools exposed by the Gemini CLI (google-gemini/gemini-cli). engineer-agent does not inject this list into prompts; backends use their native tool names. See docs/tools/ for your CLI version.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read file contents (text, images, PDFs, etc. per CLI)

tools.name: grep_search
tools.description: Search for a regex pattern in file contents

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List files and subdirectories in a path

tools.name: run_shell_command
tools.description: Run a shell command (may require approval in some modes)

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Apply in-place edits to a file (Gemini CLI file edit tool)

notes: Kilo CLI exposes different tool names; use FILE_WRITE blocks in engineer-agent output for cross-backend file artifacts.
